name: @qgis-sdk/bridge
description: Typed QWebChannel bridge for QGIS plugins — window-like EventTarget, complete QGIS Web API (layers, tasks, network, messageBar), React/Vue/Svelte/Web Components adapters, description loader (no codegen), built with bun

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/react.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/vue.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/svelte.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/webcomponents.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/loader.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/qgis.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/window.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/description.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly

author: qgis-rs contributors
